plainTranslation: With Composite Mercury in the 2nd house, this can be a good placement for a business relationship, and you can focus on the plans and ways you can create wealth and accumulate values together. In a personal relationship, you can take your time getting your points across, and you may be more stubborn about your viewpoints with one another, so you need to make sure you're being open about your differences with your beliefs and opinions. You may not be quick to get into fights, but can get stuck on them when you do, so try not to hold on to grudges with one another.
policy: Composite chart entries describe the relationship as a third entity. Read alongside synastry; do not use as a verdict on whether a relationship should continue.
